# Harbor index lock

Local Linux filesystem. The supplied descriptor is valid. Another process already holds an exclusive flock on the same file through an independently opened descriptor and keeps it held. No signals are delivered.

turns.prompt: First open this page before answering: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/flock.2.html . Read src/lock_exit.c and notes/locking.md. Under the documented LOCK_NB behavior and the local conditions, what integer does lock_exit return? Read only; do not run or modify the project.
